mapper.sql: select p.*,null as topic_name from fund_use_plan p where p.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: and p.topic_id=#{topicId} and p.status=#{status} order by p.plan_time desc,p.use_plan_id desc
select count(1) from fund_use_plan where topic_id=#{topicId} and del_flag='0'
select coalesce(sum(plan_amount),0) from fund_use_plan where topic_id=#{topicId} and del_flag='0' and use_plan_id != #{excludeUsePlanId}
mapper.update: update fund_use_plan set use_name=#{useName},plan_amount=#{planAmount},responsible_user_id=#{responsibleUserId},responsible_user_name=#{responsibleUserName},plan_time=#{planTime},fund_desc=#{fundDesc},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where use_plan_id=#{usePlanId} and del_flag='0'

update fund_use_plan set status='1',actual_amount=#{actual},difference_amount=#{difference},finish_type=#{finishType},finish_reason=#{reason},finish_user_id=#{finishUserId},finish_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where use_plan_id=#{usePlanId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'
update fund_use_plan set del_flag='2',update_time=sysdate() where use_plan_id=#{usePlanId}
